files.description: Raw, unmodified Overpass API JSON response: 1150 amenity=atm nodes within a bounding box covering greater Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.

Terminals table (1150 rows) built from the raw OSM ATM nodes: real lat/lon/h3_cell (H3 res 9), synthetic bank name and install_date columns per docs/DATA_SCHEMA.md. Identical content also saved to data/simulated/fixture/terminals.parquet for early Model/API integration.
